note: related_topic_ids: gán bằng keyword + sửa tay — giáo viên review

templates.pattern: As / Whereas / While X verb, Y verb (at the same time).
examples: While the figure for factories in Japan went up dramatically to 120,000 in 2010, the quantity in Korea plummeted to 12,000 at the same time.

templates.pattern: In comparison to / with X, which verb, Y verb.
examples: In comparison with the number of factories in Japan, which witnessed a dramatic increase to 120,000 in 2010, the quantity in Korea plummeted to 12,000 at this time.

templates.pattern: X verb, Verb-ing / which verb (nối vế so sánh).
examples: The quantity of factories in Japan went through a period of dramatic increase to 120,000 in 2010, exceeding the number in Korea, which had only 12,000.
The number of students in high school increased, exceeding the figure for secondary school.

templates.pattern: Clause, followed by + Noun Phrase.
examples: There was a dramatic growth in the number of factories in Japan to 120,000 in 2010, followed by a sharp decrease to 1,000 in 2015.

templates.pattern: Clause, prior to / before + Verb-ing.
examples: The number of factories in Japan experienced an increase to 120,000 in 2010, before hitting a free fall to 1,000 in 2015.

templates.pattern: Clause, after + Verb-ing.
examples: The figure for factories in Japan hit a free fall to 1,000 in 2015, after undergoing an increase to 120,000 in 2010.

templates.pattern: X was + comparative + than Y / X was the highest / lowest.
examples: The consumption of coffee was significantly higher than that of tea throughout the period.
notes: "that of / those of" dùng để tránh lặp danh từ khi so sánh.

templates.pattern: X + verb (trend) + adverb + to / at + figure (in year).
examples: Car sales rose steadily to 5 million units in 2020.

templates.pattern: There was a + adj + noun (trend) + in X.
examples: There was a sharp increase in the number of tourists between 2000 and 2010.

templates.pattern: X saw / witnessed / experienced + a + adj + noun.
examples: The unemployment rate witnessed a gradual decline over the decade.

templates.pattern: After + Verb-ing …, X + verb (giai đoạn nối tiếp).
examples: After peaking at 80% in 2015, the figure gradually dropped to 50%.
notes: Cặp từ hay dùng: dramatically / sharply / significantly (mạnh) — gradually / steadily / slightly (nhẹ).

templates.section: Nhóm & Nêu bật số liệu (Grouping / Highlighting)
templates.pattern: The largest / smallest proportion of … belonged to X.
examples: The largest proportion of household spending belonged to housing, at 35%.

templates.section: Nhóm & Nêu bật số liệu (Grouping / Highlighting)
templates.pattern: X accounted for / made up + figure of the total.
examples: Renewable energy accounted for nearly a quarter of total electricity production.

templates.section: Nhóm & Nêu bật số liệu (Grouping / Highlighting)
templates.pattern: X was followed by Y and Z, at … respectively.
examples: The most popular activity was reading, followed by gaming and cooking, at 40%, 25% and 15% respectively.

templates.pattern: Overall, it is clear that … / Overall, X … while Y ….
examples: Overall, it is clear that car ownership rose across all regions, while public transport use declined.

templates.pattern: In general, the most noticeable trend / feature is that ….
examples: In general, the most noticeable feature is that men consistently outspent women in every category.
notes: Overview = KHÔNG số liệu, chỉ nêu xu hướng/đặc điểm chính. Bắt buộc phải có.

templates.pattern: First / Then / After that / Finally + passive voice.
examples: First, the raw materials are collected. Then they are heated and shaped into blocks.

templates.pattern: Once X has been done, Y is + past participle.
examples: Once the mixture has been prepared, it is poured into moulds.

templates.pattern: X is + p.p., before being + p.p. / after which ….
examples: The beans are roasted, before being ground into powder.
notes: Process ưu tiên bị động (passive) + từ nối trình tự; hạn chế "I / we".

templates.section: Map (Bản đồ / thay đổi vị trí)
templates.pattern: X was replaced by / converted into Y.
examples: The forest to the north was cleared and replaced by a residential area.

templates.section: Map (Bản đồ / thay đổi vị trí)
templates.pattern: A new X was built / constructed in the … of the area.
examples: A new shopping mall was constructed in the centre of the town.

templates.section: Map (Bản đồ / thay đổi vị trí)
templates.pattern: X was expanded / extended / demolished / relocated to ….
examples: The small harbour was expanded and a marina was added to the east.
notes: Map thay đổi theo thời gian → dùng thì quá khứ + bị động; nêu phương hướng (north/south/east/west, adjacent to).

templates.pattern: It is often argued / claimed that + [paraphrase đề].
examples: It is often argued that governments should invest more in public transport than in new roads.

templates.pattern: While some people believe X, others contend that Y.
examples: While some people believe that technology isolates us, others contend that it brings people closer together.

templates.pattern: This essay will argue that … / In my opinion, ….
examples: This essay will argue that the benefits of remote work outweigh its drawbacks.

templates.section: Topic Sentence (câu chủ đề đoạn thân bài)
templates.pattern: One (major) reason / advantage / argument is that ….
examples: One major advantage of studying abroad is exposure to different cultures.

templates.section: Topic Sentence (câu chủ đề đoạn thân bài)
templates.pattern: The main reason why … is that ….
examples: The main reason why cities are becoming overcrowded is the lack of rural employment.

templates.pattern: This is because … / This means that ….
examples: This is because a shorter commute leaves employees more time to rest and be productive.

templates.pattern: For instance / A clear example of this is ….
examples: A clear example of this is Finland, where free education has produced high literacy rates.

templates.pattern: As a result / Consequently, ….
examples: As a result, workers become more motivated and less likely to leave their jobs.

templates.section: Opinion & Concession (nêu ý kiến + nhượng bộ)
templates.pattern: While it is true that X, I believe that Y.
examples: While it is true that fast food is convenient, I believe its health costs are too high.

templates.section: Opinion & Concession (nêu ý kiến + nhượng bộ)
templates.pattern: Admittedly, … . However, ….
examples: Admittedly, building new roads can ease traffic in the short term. However, it encourages more car use over time.

templates.section: Opinion & Concession (nêu ý kiến + nhượng bộ)
templates.pattern: There is no doubt that … , yet ….
examples: There is no doubt that tourism boosts the economy, yet it can damage local environments.

templates.pattern: X leads to / results in / gives rise to Y.
examples: Rapid urbanisation gives rise to serious housing shortages.

templates.pattern: This problem could be tackled / addressed by + Verb-ing.
examples: This problem could be addressed by investing in affordable public housing.

templates.pattern: One effective solution would be to + V.
examples: One effective solution would be to impose higher taxes on private vehicles.

templates.pattern: In conclusion, … / To sum up, ….
examples: In conclusion, although both views have merit, the advantages clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

templates.pattern: Overall, it is clear that … and therefore ….
examples: Overall, it is clear that education is the key factor, and therefore it deserves the greatest investment.
notes: Conclusion = nhắc lại quan điểm (paraphrase thesis), KHÔNG thêm ý mới, KHÔNG ví dụ mới.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: Clause, and / but / so / yet + clause.
examples: Public transport reduces traffic, but many people still prefer private cars.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: Clause; moreover / however / therefore, clause.
examples: Renewable energy is clean; however, it remains expensive to install.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: Not only + clause, but + S + also + clause. (đảo ngữ)
examples: Not only does exercise improve health, but it also boosts mental wellbeing.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: Although / Even though + clause, clause. (nhượng bộ)
examples: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks face-to-face interaction.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: While / Whereas + clause, clause. (tương phản)
examples: Whereas cities offer more jobs, rural areas provide a cleaner environment.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: If / Unless + clause, clause. (điều kiện)
examples: Unless governments act now, pollution will continue to rise.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: S + who / which / that + clause (mệnh đề quan hệ)
examples: Students who study abroad often gain valuable independence.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.pattern: …, which + clause (relative bổ nghĩa cả câu)
examples: Many families own two cars, which worsens urban congestion.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.subgroup: Nhóm C — Rút gọn & nâng cao
templates.pattern: Verb-ing …, clause. (participle mở đầu)
examples: Facing rising costs, many students choose local universities.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.subgroup: Nhóm C — Rút gọn & nâng cao
templates.pattern: Clause, thereby / thus + Verb-ing. (nêu kết quả)
examples: Renewable energy cuts emissions, thereby slowing climate change.

templates.section: Câu ghép & Câu phức (Complex / Compound — nâng band GRA)
templates.subgroup: Nhóm C — Rút gọn & nâng cao
templates.pattern: By + Verb-ing, S + can + V. (nêu phương tiện)
examples: By investing in education, governments can reduce long-term poverty.
